title: Remove Aikido origin runtime blocking and telemetry

endpoints.before: Requests reaching the Node origin passed globally installed Aikido runtime instrumentation and middleware, which could send request/security telemetry and impose Aikido-specific blocking or rate-limit grouping before the route handler.
endpoints.after: The updated origin no longer loads the Aikido SDK, sends its runtime telemetry, creates its IP/UA-derived user identity, or applies its blocking/grouping. Existing authentication, origin access controls, gateway quotas, legacy rate limits and custom legacy anti-abuse remain. Gateway-local responses that never reach the origin retain their prior behavior. v1 remains outside custom legacy challenges. Historical provider data is not erased by this code change; origin deployment is required.
endpoints.clientAction: None. Continue honoring existing authentication, quotas and Retry-After responses. This record does not confirm production deployment.
